slbfe_registration_fee_lkr.note: Initial SLBFE registration fee (Rs. 18,200 + 18% VAT + 2.5% SSCL), paid to SLBFE, can be paid online. Registration is compulsory before leaving (SLBFE Act s.53(3)).

domestic_middle_east_agency_fee_lkr.note: SLBFE reports that no recruitment fees are charged for domestic work in Middle Eastern countries; the employer deposits a USD 1,500 safe deposit.

highest_published_cap_lkr.note: Highest Maximum Amount Chargeable by Sri Lanka Agency among currently valid SLBFE-approved job orders in data/kb/slbfe_job_orders.csv (32,686 orders from 540 agencies, crawled 2026-10-17); the top order is Moldova hotel/kitchen staff, licence 2963. The verifier recomputes this from the CSV at run time and uses this value only if the CSV is missing. It replaces the earlier Rs. 450,000 figure (Romania, 2022), which current orders far exceed (e.g. Japan SSW Agriculture Rs. 1,119,985, approved 27 Nov 2025). Fees are checked against the matching job order first; this global cap is only the fallback.

professional_jobs.note: Jobs in the SLBFE Professional manpower level. SLBFE reports no recruitment fees in professional categories where the employer bears recruitment costs.
